⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. <details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8031f49df40f4dbcb71f16d27e628665557a5457` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `@object-ui/i18n`'s published `useObjectLabel()` gains one member, `actionPreflight`, and removes none.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: no schema or authorable key changes. The one `packages/spec/**` file is the liveness ledger's `preflight` note, which closes the gap the note itself named.

- **The result-dialog path is unchanged.** Its `fields` read moves into `readActionFieldsNode(…, 'resultDialog')`, which builds the same `actionSuffixes(objectName, actionName, 'resultDialog.fields')` that `suffixesFor('fields')` built. The overlay moves into `overlayActionFieldLabels` with the same rules: a literal-path index, a non-empty string replaces the label, and anything else keeps the authored label.
- **The preflight key matches the REST side.** It is `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.preflight.fields.PATH`, and with no key object it is `globalActions.ACTION.preflight.fields.PATH`. This is the key `resolveActionPreflight` reads (#31885).
  - Only declared rows are overlaid. A bundle path no row declares adds nothing, and an inline per-locale label survives when no bundle string exists.
  - These cases are pinned in the new 31937 file.
- **Both handlers are wired the same way.** `useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView` pass `action.preflight` through `actionPreflight` only when it is set. Both add `actionPreflight` to their callback deps.
  - The two `banCompanion-30205` suites drive each handler with a zh bundle string.
  - The dev reports 2 ablation pins red and 3 controls green, all restored.
- **The identity pin moves from 30 to 31 members.** That is the one new member, and it is a test of `useObjectLabel`, inside the claim's "its tests". Accepted.

### ② Semver level

`@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch: a widening. That is RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `check:liveness` exits 0 on the rewritten note (dev).
- CI is in progress on this head. The ACCEPT reads it, including `Type Check UI`'s `check:spec-symbols`, which `dispatch-gates` does not derive. No new type takes a spec export's name.
- `open_questions`: none.
